children: Trader Bonk Guy said his portfolio is down more than $24.5 million from its all-time high and denied secretly selling assets through other wallets.

According to Odaily, Bonk Guy said in a post on X that his cumulative gains through the FOMO platform were about $1.57 million, roughly one-sixteenth of the portfolio’s drawdown. He said the allegations of secret sales through other wallets had not been supported by evidence and called on anyone with evidence to disclose it publicly.

title: Bonk Guy Says Portfolio Is Down More Than $24.5 Million From Peak, Denies Secret Sales Through Other Wallets
